answer: Put every new identity on a spiral escalation ladder: it starts at level 0 with a 1-token check, but each public flag — duplicate vote, shared funder, or lockstep timing — moves it up one level and multiplies its next verification cost by five, to 5, then 25, then 125 tokens, plus a live test at level 2. At level 3 the vertex is frozen and its vault of pending rewards is burned. One honest agent rarely gets flagged and stays cheap; a farmer running 100 fakes trips flags across the cluster and must pay the escalating fee for each one or lose them all.
